# Regression tests

Eating a character after a partially consumed tab.

```````````````````````````````` example
* foo
→bar
.
<ul>
<li>foo
bar</li>
</ul>
````````````````````````````````

Type 7 HTML block followed by whitespace (#98).

```````````````````````````````` example
<a>  
x
.
<a>  
x
````````````````````````````````

h2..h6 raw HTML blocks (jgm/CommonMark#430).

```````````````````````````````` example
<h1>lorem</h1>

<h2>lorem</h2>

<h3>lorem</h3>

<h4>lorem</h4>

<h5>lorem</h5>

<h6>lorem</h6>
.
<h1>lorem</h1>
<h2>lorem</h2>
<h3>lorem</h3>
<h4>lorem</h4>
<h5>lorem</h5>
<h6>lorem</h6>
````````````````````````````````

Issue #109 - tabs after setext header line


```````````````````````````````` example
hi
--→
.
<h2>hi</h2>
````````````````````````````````

Issue #108 - Chinese punctuation not recognized

```````````````````````````````` example
**。**话
.
<p>**。**话</p>
````````````````````````````````

Issue jgm/cmark#177 - incorrect emphasis parsing

```````````````````````````````` example
a***b* c*
.
<p>a*<em><em>b</em> c</em></p>
````````````````````````````````

Issue jgm/CommonMark#468 - backslash at end of link definition


```````````````````````````````` example
[\]: test
.
<p>[]: test</p>
````````````````````````````````

Issue jgm/commonmark.js#121 - punctuation set different

```````````````````````````````` example
^_test_
.
<p>^<em>test</em></p>
````````````````````````````````

Issue #116 - tabs before and after ATX closing heading
```````````````````````````````` example
# foo→#→
.
<h1>foo</h1>
````````````````````````````````

commonmark/CommonMark#493 - escaped space not allowed in link destination.

```````````````````````````````` example
[link](a\ b)
.
<p>[link](a\ b)</p>
````````````````````````````````

Issue #527 - meta tags in inline contexts

```````````````````````````````` example
City:
<span itemprop="contentLocation" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/City">
  <meta itemprop="name" content="Springfield">
</span>
.
<p>City:
<span itemprop="contentLocation" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/City">
<meta itemprop="name" content="Springfield">
</span></p>
````````````````````````````````

Double-encoding.

```````````````````````````````` example
[XSS](javascript&amp;colon;alert%28&#039;XSS&#039;%29)
.
<p><a href="javascript&amp;colon;alert('XSS')">XSS</a></p>
````````````````````````````````

Issue commonamrk#517 - script, pre, style close tag without
opener.

```````````````````````````````` example
</script>

</pre>

</style>
.
</script>
</pre>
</style>
````````````````````````````````

Issue #289.

```````````````````````````````` example
[a](<b) c>
.
<p>[a](&lt;b) c&gt;</p>
````````````````````````````````

icyleaf/markd issue #80

```````````````````````````````` example
1212121212121
.
<p>1212121212121</p>
````````````````````````````````

Raw HTML and line breaks inside an image's alt text are written as text,
as cmark writes them.

```````````````````````````````` example
![<b x="">a</b>
b\
c](/i.png)
.
<p><img src="/i.png" alt="&lt;b x=&quot;&quot;&gt;a&lt;/b&gt; b c" /></p>
````````````````````````````````

An entity's name is 2 to 32 letters and digits, closed by `;`; anything
else is text. A numeric reference past U+FFFF names its character, and one
past U+10FFFF names none.

```````````````````````````````` example
&; &x; &a b; &copy; &#x1F600; &#128512; &#x110000;
.
<p>&amp;; &amp;x; &amp;a b; © 😀 😀 �</p>
````````````````````````````````

A numeric reference in a destination ends with `;`, and one too long for
a number names no character.

```````````````````````````````` example
[a](/&#650) [b](/&#x3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c;) [c](/&#x1F600;)
.
<p><a href="/&amp;#650">a</a> <a href="/&amp;#x3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c;">b</a> <a href="/%F0%9F%98%80">c</a></p>
````````````````````````````````

A code span closes at the first later run of backticks of its opener's
length.

```````````````````````````````` example
``a`b```c`` `d` \``e``
.
<p><code>a`b```c</code> <code>d</code> ``e``</p>
````````````````````````````````

An extended autolink's trailing punctuation is read again as text, once.

```````````````````````````````` example autolink
x www.a.com/x) www.a.com/x) y, see http://a.com/(b)) ok, *www.a.com/c* and ćao a.b@c.com.
.
<p>x <a href="http://www.a.com/x">www.a.com/x</a>) <a href="http://www.a.com/x">www.a.com/x</a>) y, see <a href="http://a.com/(b)">http://a.com/(b)</a>) ok, <em><a href="http://www.a.com/c">www.a.com/c</a></em> and ćao <a href="mailto:a.b@c.com">a.b@c.com</a>.</p>
````````````````````````````````

A destination holds at most 32 nested parentheses, as cmark reads it.

```````````````````````````````` example
[a](((((((((((((((((((((((((((((((((x))))))))))))))))))))))))))))))))) [b]((((((((((((((((((((((((((((((((((x))))))))))))))))))))))))))))))))))
.
<p><a href="((((((((((((((((((((((((((((((((x))))))))))))))))))))))))))))))))">a</a> [b]((((((((((((((((((((((((((((((((((x))))))))))))))))))))))))))))))))))</p>
````````````````````````````````

A title in parentheses holds no unescaped `(`, and a backslash takes the
character after it, as commonmark.js reads them.

```````````````````````````````` example
[a](b (c\(d)) [e](f (g(h))) [i](j "k\") [l](m "n\\")
.
<p><a href="b" title="c(d">a</a> [e](f (g(h))) [i](j &quot;k&quot;) <a href="m" title="n\">l</a></p>
````````````````````````````````

A link label holds at most 999 characters.

```````````````````````````````` example
[]: /a
[]: /b

[] []
.
<p>[]: /b</p>
<p><a href="/a"></a> []</p>
````````````````````````````````

A no-break space is whitespace on either side of a delimiter.

```````````````````````````````` example
*a* b a *b*
.
<p><em>a</em> b a <em>b</em></p>
````````````````````````````````

A tab after a block quote marker indented by spaces expands from the
marker's column.

```````````````````````````````` example
  >→→foo
.
<blockquote>
<pre><code>foo
</code></pre>
</blockquote>
````````````````````````````````

Blocks in containers on lines that are not ASCII.

```````````````````````````````` example gfm
> - ćao
>   # Žabe #
>   ```ž
>   č
>   ```
> 1. đ | e

|ä|b|
|-|-|
|ö|ü|
.
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ćao
<h1>Žabe</h1>
<pre><code class="language-ž">č
</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
<ol>
<li>đ | e</li>
</ol>
</blockquote>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>ä</th>
<th>b</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>ö</td>
<td>ü</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
````````````````````````````````

A long row that is not a delimiter row ends a table's header, and reading
it does not raise.

```````````````````````````````` example gfm
|a|b|
|- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - x
.
<p>|a|b|
|- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - x</p>
````````````````````````````````

A `-` list item ends a table, as `*` and `+` items do.

```````````````````````````````` example gfm
|a|
|-|
|b|
- c
.
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>a</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>b</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<ul>
<li>c</li>
</ul>
````````````````````````````````
